data.exact_reserve_text: The Syndicate's cumulative incurred claims development table shows a decrease in the estimated ultimate gross claims for underwriting years 2011, 2012, and 2013 during 2015.
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a gross prior year reserve release of GBP 6.283 million, representing an 8.2% reduction in opening gross reserves. This favorable development was calculated from the gross claims development table, showing decreases in the estimated ultimate gross claims for the 2011, 2012, and 2013 underwriting years. No specific events or lines of business were identified as driving these movements.
raw_causal_phrases: past experience of the development of claims over time
Adjustments to the amounts of claims provisions established in prior years are reflected in the financial statements for the period in which the adjustments are made.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development was calculated from the gross claims development table as no explicit 'Movement in prior year's provision' note was available. LOB-specific movements could not be determined as the claims development table is not broken down by LOB.
